brief: A meeting scheduler where time flows as a river — free slots are calm water, meetings are bridges

dominant_strengths: Clear time-axis hierarchy with consistent left-rail hours and well-aligned slot rows reads quickly as a schedule
The river-blue gradient and gradient-glow free slots gesture meaningfully toward the 'calm water' metaphor
Avatar pills and dashed empty slots create a legible distinction between booked and bookable moments
dominant_weaknesses: Rust-orange 'bridge' meetings clash harshly against the saturated cobalt water — complementary collision rather than harmony
The bridge metaphor is literal and flat; no piers, arcs, or crossing motion — bridges read as orange bars, breaking poetry
Static screenshot shows no current-time indicator, no flow animation, no water ripple — the 'river' premise is unfulfilled
fix_priorities: Replace orange bridges with tonal warm-wood or stone textures and arched silhouettes spanning the time channel
Add a subtle flowing-water animation and a 'now' meniscus line to make time feel like motion, not rows
Soften background blue saturation and introduce depth layering so bridges sit above water rather than fighting it
Refine typography hierarchy — meeting titles need more weight contrast against the heavy orange fill
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral utility is decent but visceral impact is undermined by jarring color and reflective metaphor remains shallow.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially fits — the river/bridge concept is named and gestured at, but execution reads as a standard calendar with mismatched orange bars.
